verdict.rationale: HubSpot's official MCP server gives any MCP-compatible agent secure read access to CRM data, explicitly including contacts, deals and engagements, which covers open deals and activity history for an account brief. Connected inboxes log email replies to the CRM, so recent emails are plausibly available as engagements. A probe confirms the MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that email content and activity timelines can be retrieved per company via MCP/API, documentation of company/account-level association queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent building a pre-meeting brief.
